description: Measure the decay from in-sample to out-of-sample performance and flag parameter-rich strategies. After a backtest, before trusting its in-sample performance. Do not choose this when a full statistical overfitting test is required. Example requests: Check this backtest for overfitting. | How much performance does this strategy lose out of sample? | Flag the overfitting risk in these results.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

results.description: The customer's results.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. In-sample and out-of-sample results. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_backtest_overfitting_check
title: Backtest overfitting check
